cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, tell me whether the flat was too quiet. A proper answer, please, not a report on the rent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One answer at a time. Yours first: when you heard a key, did you hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I called our landline just to hear you. Now say hello the way you did then, please. Leave the gas bill until after the greeting.

reason: Make precise answer sequencing and greeting correction the way A obtains B longing first, then supplies a specific reciprocal admission.
